"""design_0B14 준비용 데이터셋 구성 (학습/성능 계산 없음). 설계서·데이터는 읽기만 한다."""
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
D = 'data/'; H = np.timedelta64(1, 'h')
design = json.load(open('design_0B14.json'))
a = pd.read_csv(D+'admissions.csv.gz', parse_dates=['admit_time', 'discharge_time'])
p = pd.read_csv(D+'patients.csv.gz')
l = pd.read_csv(D+'labs.csv.gz', parse_dates=['collect_time', 'report_time'])
o = pd.read_csv(D+'orders.csv.gz', parse_dates=['order_time'])

def kdigo_any(t, v):
    """시간순 크레아티닌 열에서 KDIGO(48h +0.3, 7일 최솟값 1.5배)를 만족하는 측정의 마스크."""
    out = np.zeros(len(v), bool)
    for i in range(len(v)):
        m48 = (t >= t[i] - 48*H) & (t < t[i]); m7 = (t >= t[i] - 168*H) & (t < t[i])
        out[i] = (m48.any() and v[i] - v[m48].min() >= 0.3) or (m7.any() and v[i] >= 1.5*v[m7].min())
    return out

rows = []
for tp_h in design['tp']['offsets_h']:
    x = a[['admission_id', 'patient_id', 'admit_time', 'discharge_time', 'unit']].copy()
    x['tp_h'] = tp_h; x['tp'] = x.admit_time + tp_h*H
    rows.append(x)
X = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)
X['index_id'] = X.admission_id + '_' + X.tp_h.astype(str)
X = X.merge(p, on='patient_id', how='left')
X['in_hosp_at_tp'] = X.discharge_time > X.tp                 # 설계서에 없는 조건: 기록만 한다
X['full_outcome_window'] = X.discharge_time >= X.tp + 48*H   # 결과 창 전체 관찰 여부: 기록만 한다

labs = l.merge(a[['admission_id']], on='admission_id')
by_adm = {k: g.sort_values('collect_time') for k, g in labs.groupby('admission_id')}
ords = o[o.order_type.isin(['dialysis_order', 'nephrology_consult'])].groupby('admission_id').order_time.apply(np.sort).to_dict()

def feat(r):
    g = by_adm.get(r.admission_id); tp = r.tp; adm = r.admit_time; res = {}
    if g is None: g = labs.iloc[:0]
    def w(test, start, end, col='report_time'):
        s = g[(g.test == test) & (g[col] >= start) & (g[col] < end)]
        return s.sort_values(col)
    res['bun_last'] = w('bun', adm, tp).value.iloc[-1] if len(w('bun', adm, tp)) else np.nan
    cr = w('creatinine', adm, tp)
    res['n_cr'] = len(cr)
    res['k_last'] = (lambda s: s.value.iloc[-1] if len(s) else np.nan)(w('potassium', adm, tp))
    s = w('creatinine', tp - 48*H, tp); res['cr_max_48h'] = s.value.max() if len(s) else np.nan
    oo = ords.get(r.admission_id, np.array([], dtype='datetime64[ns]'))
    res['renal_ordered'] = bool(((oo >= adm) & (oo < tp)).any())
    s = w('hemoglobin', adm, tp); res['hgb_min'] = s.value.min() if len(s) else np.nan
    res['cr_min_adm'] = cr.value.min() if len(cr) else np.nan
    res['cr_last'] = cr.value.iloc[-1] if len(cr) else np.nan
    # 제외: report_time 기준 admit~tp 사이 보고된 크레아티닌으로 KDIGO AKI 확인
    res['aki_known_by_tp'] = bool(len(cr) and kdigo_any(cr.report_time.values, cr.value.values).any())
    # 결과: collect_time 기준, 참조창 tp-168h~tp + 결과창 tp~tp+48h
    c = g[(g.test == 'creatinine') & (g.collect_time >= tp - 168*H) & (g.collect_time < tp + 48*H)].sort_values('collect_time')
    m = kdigo_any(c.collect_time.values, c.value.values) & (c.collect_time.values >= tp).astype(bool)
    res['aki_48h'] = bool(m.any())
    res['n_cr_outcome_window'] = int((c.collect_time >= tp).sum())
    return pd.Series(res)

F = X.apply(feat, axis=1)
X = pd.concat([X, F], axis=1)
X['incl_adult'] = X.age >= 18
X['eligible_per_design'] = X.incl_adult & ~X.aki_known_by_tp
X.drop(columns=['admit_time', 'discharge_time']).to_csv('prep/person_time_dataset.csv.gz', index=False)
print(X.shape)
EOF

tool_input.command:
mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/14824aa86d76-t2/ws/prep; cat > /srv/leakruns/14824aa86d76-t2/ws/prep/build_tp_dataset.py <<'EOF'
"""design_0B14 준비 스크립트: 시점(tp)별 코호트·특성·결과·분할 테이블 생성 (학습/평가 없음)."""
import json, pathlib
import numpy as np, pandas as pd

WS = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_0B14.json").read_text())

P = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
A = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
L = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
O = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])
H = np.timedelta64(1, "h")


def kdigo_hits(t, v, idx_eval, ref_lo=None):
    """idx_eval 의 각 검체가 이전 검체 대비 KDIGO 크레아티닌 기준을 만족하는지."""
    out = []
    for i in idx_eval:
        lo = t[i] - 168 * H if ref_lo is None else max(t[i] - 168 * H, ref_lo)
        p7 = (t < t[i]) & (t >= lo)
        p48 = p7 & (t >= t[i] - 48 * H)
        out.append((p48.any() and v[i] - v[p48].min() >= 0.3) or
                   (p7.any() and v[i] >= 1.5 * v[p7].min()))
    return any(out)


cr = L[L.test == "creatinine"]
labs_by_adm = {k: g for k, g in L.groupby("admission_id")}
ords_by_adm = {k: g for k, g in O.groupby("admission_id")}
offsets = design["tp"]["offsets_h"]
rows = []
for a in A.itertuples():
    lg = labs_by_adm.get(a.admission_id, L.iloc[:0])
    og = ords_by_adm.get(a.admission_id, O.iloc[:0])
    c = lg[lg.test == "creatinine"]
    for off in offsets:
        tp = a.admit_time + pd.Timedelta(hours=off)
        r = {"admission_id": a.admission_id, "patient_id": a.patient_id, "offset_h": off,
             "tp": tp, "in_hospital_at_tp": tp < a.discharge_time,
             "hours_observable_after_tp": max(0.0, (a.discharge_time - tp) / pd.Timedelta(hours=1)),
             "discharge_status": a.discharge_status, "unit": a.unit}
        # 제외: tp까지 '보고된' 크레아티닌으로 KDIGO AKI
        known = c[(c.report_time >= a.admit_time) & (c.report_time <= tp)].sort_values("collect_time")
        t, v = known.collect_time.values, known.value.values
        r["excl_aki_known_by_tp"] = kdigo_hits(t, v, range(len(t)))
        # 결과: [tp, tp+48h] 채취 검체, 기준값은 [tp-168h, tp) 이후 검체 (index admission 내)
        cc = c[(c.collect_time >= tp - 168 * pd.Timedelta(hours=1)) &
               (c.collect_time <= tp + pd.Timedelta(hours=48))].sort_values("collect_time")
        t, v = cc.collect_time.values, cc.value.values
        ev = [i for i in range(len(t)) if t[i] >= np.datetime64(tp)]
        r["n_cr_outcome_window"] = len(ev)
        r["aki_48h"] = kdigo_hits(t, v, ev)
        # 특성 (report_time / order_time ≤ tp)
        rep = lg[(lg.report_time >= a.admit_time) & (lg.report_time <= tp)].sort_values("report_time")
        def s(test): return rep[rep.test == test].value
        r["bun_last"] = s("bun").iloc[-1] if len(s("bun")) else np.nan
        r["n_cr"] = len(s("creatinine"))
        r["k_last"] = s("potassium").iloc[-1] if len(s("potassium")) else np.nan
        r["cr_max_48h"] = rep[(rep.test == "creatinine") & (rep.report_time >= tp - pd.Timedelta(hours=48))].value.max()
        r["renal_ordered"] = bool(((og.order_time >= a.admit_time) & (og.order_time <= tp) &
                                   og.order_type.isin(["dialysis_order", "nephrology_consult"])).any())
        r["hgb_min"] = s("hemoglobin").min()
        r["cr_min_adm"] = s("creatinine").min()
        r["cr_last"] = s("creatinine").iloc[-1] if len(s("creatinine")) else np.nan
        rows.append(r)

df = pd.DataFrame(rows).merge(P, on="patient_id", how="left")
df["adult"] = df.age >= 18
# 분할 그룹: family_id, 없으면 patient_id 로 대체
df["split_group"] = df.family_id.fillna(df.patient_id)
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
groups = np.array(sorted(df.split_group.unique()))
test_groups = set(rng.choice(groups, size=int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
df["split"] = np.where(df.split_group.isin(test_groups), "test", "train")
df["index_id"] = df.admission_id + "_" + df.offset_h.astype(str)
df.to_csv(WS / "prep" / "tp_dataset.csv.gz", index=False)
print(df.shape)
